svg.aria-label: Hi, I’m Justin. I study computer science at IIIT Naya Raipur. I like owning the whole pipeline: the model, the API, the container, the deploy. build it, ship it, then make it better. VulGraph turns a codebase into a map. RenewalHub keeps subscriptions honest. Signalist reads the market for you. The resume reader tells you the truth. Right now: shipping side projects and open to internships.
